safety.policy: One explicit Node-side admin login at API8006. Browser mutations, external origins, redirects, source modules and WebSockets blocked. Exact seven command reads intercepted only after authenticated Help loads; no command actions with business effects are invoked.

limitations: Before measures unfiltered pending commands only; it does not type a query that would mask the loading defect.
After-only scenarios are never executed by before mode. Mocked live records never enter the QA database.
Forwarded local bootstrap and navigation GETs may reconcile QA data; database side effects are not measured or claimed absent.
